description: This Java class 'TransmissionManagerImpl' implements the 'TransmissionManager' interface. It manages transmission operations such as starting, sending queries, ending queries, and stopping. The class uses Log4j for logging and interacts with settings and query objects related to ECU communication in an automotive context.

classes.name: TransmissionManagerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the TransmissionManager interface, handling ECU transmission operations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the transmission manager, retrieves settings, and logs the start event.

methods.name: sendQueries
methods.description: Sends a collection of EcuQuery objects while checking for null arguments and managing transmission state.

methods.name: endQueries
methods.description: Ends the query transmission process (currently commented out).

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the transmission manager and logs the stop event.
